name: hacker-background
title: Hacker Background
description: A canvas of bright green letters raining down in narrow columns over black, each column leaving a fading tail. It fills its area and sits behind whatever text you layer on top.
use: A page needs an instant hacker or cyberpunk mood behind a short headline.
avoid: Green on black fights light themes, and the constant motion distracts from long text.
a11y: The canvas is purely decorative yet has no aria-hidden and no reduced-motion check, so the rain never stops. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black surface covered in thin vertical columns of small monospaced green characters. The brightest letter sits at the head of each column and the characters above it dim into a greyer trail, so the rain looks denser near the top and sparse towards the bottom.
behaves: Random letters fall column by column at roughly thirty frames a second, each pass painting a faint dark wash that slowly wipes away the tails. When a column reaches the bottom it restarts at the top at a random moment, so the pattern never repeats.
customise: Colour, font size and fall speed are props; the character set and the fade strength are written into the canvas loop.
weight: moderate: A full-canvas 2D text redraw about thirty times a second, constant but cheap per frame.
